title: Settings
subtitle: Demo auto-import applies right after saving — no container restart needed. Values are stored in the data volume and take priority over environment variables.
watchDirs: Paths inside the container (one folder per line)
watchDirsHint: The folders themselves must be mounted as volumes in docker-compose.yml (see the example there). The first scan only remembers existing files — anything new gets imported.
faceitKeySaved: key is saved — leave the field empty to keep it
faceitKeyHint: Free key: FACEIT Developer Portal → App Studio → your app → API Keys
faceitId: Player ID (GUID from your FACEIT profile page)
importWindowHint: Demos older than the window are not downloaded automatically — they stay in the list as suggestions and can be fetched and analyzed manually. Applies to both watch folders and FACEIT.
envNote: Variables from .env / docker-compose act as defaults: anything not saved here falls back to them.
progressSource.default: No measurements yet — default estimate in use
progressSource.measured: From median stage durations of recent analyses on this machine
progressHint: Every analysis automatically refines the distribution from real stage durations. Pin it manually with CS2_PROGRESS_WEIGHTS (JSON: stage → relative seconds).
